scope: MatchLab Field, Pose, shared context, renderer and frame-preparation boundary only. System V2 remains authoritative outside this boundary.

authorities.scientific: Accepted source artifacts and versioned Python processor outputs own values, methods, units, measurement classes and scientific interpretation.
authorities.provenance_rights: Existing RES-109 registry, checksum, processing lineage and rights gates remain authoritative and are never bypassed by a renderer.
authorities.server_data: TanStack Query owns bounded API windows, artifacts, source metadata and cache lifecycle.
authorities.transient_state: Zustand owns the live playhead, playback, hover and transient interaction state; the router owns durable deep-link context.
authorities.frame_rendering: The existing Arrow/Comlink worker prepares typed frame buffers; Three refs and GPU buffers own presentation at frame cadence.

technology.multi_view: Drei View scissor rendering shares one Canvas, renderer, scene resources and GPU context.
technology.webgpu_gate: Benchmark Three WebGPURenderer only after the final representative MatchLab scene, required TSL materials and WebGL2 baseline exist; WebGPU adoption requires target-browser compatibility and measured benefit.

state_ownership.durable_context: TanStack Router owns dataset, session/match, period/trial, canonical t_ns, selected player and view mode for reproducible deep links.
state_ownership.server_data: TanStack Query owns source metadata, rights-filtered artifacts, exact bounded frame windows and tactical processor outputs.
state_ownership.transient_interaction: Zustand owns the live canonical playhead, playback status/rate, hover, selected tactical object and renderer interaction.
state_ownership.frame_cadence: The Arrow/Comlink worker owns preparation; Three refs and typed buffers own per-frame visual mutation without React row-object rebuilding.
state_ownership.context_role: MatchFrameContext is the sole renderer-facing snapshot and action API composed from the existing owners; it creates no duplicate store or selection authority.

match_frame_context.canonical_time: Signed BigInt nanoseconds stay exact through context, routing and worker handoff; conversion to renderer units occurs only at the display boundary. Source frame resolution is independent and never uses frame-index equality.
match_frame_context.player_identity: A registered session participant subject_id is the canonical player identity. For SkillCorner it exactly matches tracking subject_id/object_id and Pose subject_id. Other sources need an explicit registered identity mapping; coordinates and proximity never establish identity.
match_frame_context.tracking_resolution: Resolve the latest real tracking frame at or before canonical t_ns only when its age is at most 1.5 nominal sample intervals; preserve its exact source timestamp, is_detected, extrapolation and gaps.
match_frame_context.pose_resolution: Resolve the latest real Pose sample at or before canonical t_ns only when its age is at most 1.5 nominal sample intervals. Preserve its exact source timestamp; otherwise report absence and the previous/next observed time without changing player or playhead. Never interpolate.

pitch.geometry_source: Positive length_m and width_m in metres from structured, registered source match metadata attached to the selected tracking stream and coordinate frame.
pitch.missing_geometry: Show unavailable geometry and its source; never infer dimensions from observed coordinate extents or substitute a decorative/default pitch.
pitch.coordinate_frame: Tracking X/Y retain the registered pitch-centred source frame. Pitch3D markings use the same metric dimensions and do not transform observations.
pitch.markings: Generate standardized IFAB markings procedurally and goals from field dimensions; optional context decoration cannot affect analytical clarity.

field_presentation.default_mode: Tactical Map uses a registered-pitch-fitted OrthographicCamera with stable margins and deterministic reset framing.
field_presentation.structure_lift: Structure Lift uses an oblique orthographic camera over the same scientific pitch-plane XY geometry.
field_presentation.optional_exploration: Perspective/Orbit is an optional exploration mode and never the tactical default.
field_presentation.depth_offset_authority: All presentation-only Field offsets are centralized in apps/web/src/components/matchlab/render-layer-depths.ts and never become scientific Z.
field_presentation.shadow_policy: Tactical Map has shadows disabled. Structure Lift enables one restrained DirectionalLight shadow map; the pitch receives the analytical ScalarFieldLayer shadow and planar tactical layers do not cast meaningful shadows. Split mode keeps Field orthographic and Pose 3D.

layers.responsibility: Tracked entities, ball, provider state, trails and player picking.
Processor-produced team/unit geometry, graphs, territory, scalar fields, events and paths.
Provider landmarks/topology, processor-declared analytical overlays, error radii and joint picking.
Selection identity, labels, source alignment evidence, and explicit source/display-mode badges.

source_alignment.rule: Draw tracking and Pose from their separate source coordinates and preserve their distinct frames.
Translate the Pose root/centroid to tracking XY for presentation only; no scale, rotation or downstream scientific use.
Translate the selected Pose foot/contact minimum to rendered pitch level while preserving relative geometry; Z remains centroid-relative.

worker_data_plane.transport: Existing Arrow JS, Web Worker and Comlink boundary with transferable ArrayBuffers and typed arrays.
prepared_outputs: typed geometry offsets and scalar grids
worker_data_plane.ownership: Worker decodes and prepares; main thread mutates Three buffers, cameras and interaction state; TanStack Query and PlaybackChunkCoordinator retain request/cache ownership.
worker_data_plane.rule: Do not build per-row object maps at animation-frame cadence, interpolate missing scientific samples or discard contract metadata.

input: declared metric id and method/model identity
scalar_fields.color_domain: Fixed and declared for the selected metric; never autoscaled frame by frame.
scalar_fields.metric_authority: Scientific processors compute values; shaders only map supplied values to a declared visual encoding.
scalar_fields.elevation: A metric-specific ElevationSpec declares scientific domain, units, elevation transform, display-height limit, pitch-plane baseline and color domain. Update mesh vertex heights from worker-prepared typed buffers without recomputing science in React or shaders. Always label ANALYTICAL ELEVATION · NOT PHYSICAL HEIGHT.

interaction.selection_authority: One MatchFrameContext selection action. Field-origin player picks commit the player and current canonical time without moving it when Pose is absent; the Pose view reports absence and the next sample. Pose-origin player switches retain RES-109 section 12 by resolving the first valid observation in the active range. Both commit player and target time together through the durable router context.
interaction.identity_mapping: Picking returns typed canonical player, Pose subject/joint, tactical-object or event identity; color alone never carries selection.
interaction.absence: Unavailable observations are explicit, never substituted with another player or fabricated at the requested time.
interaction.hover: Transient only; hover cannot change durable selection, time or scientific results.
interaction.accessibility: DOM summaries and equivalent panel actions expose the selected player, tactical object and Pose joint; keyboard selection, non-color state and reduced-motion camera behavior remain available.

steps.gate: Freeze and validate MatchLab V3 architecture, schema and ADRs before renderer implementation.
Establish one authoritative MatchFrameContext for match, period, canonical time, player and selection.
Implement bidirectional Field/Pose player selection and canonical-time contracts.
Build reusable Tracking, Tactical, Pose and Context Three layers.
Prepare tracking, Pose and tactical frames in the Arrow/Comlink worker with transferable typed buffers.
Implement one R3F Canvas with Drei scissored multi-view support.
Migrate Field from Pixi to Three/R3F and retain Pixi only as a temporary parity oracle.
Implement the generic fixed-domain scalar-field renderer.
Prove real SkillCorner Field/Pose cross-selection and synchronized playback.
Benchmark WebGL2 and WebGPU only on the final representative MatchLab scene.
Remove the production Pixi Field path only after complete parity and real-data acceptance.
Apply the RES-113 §§21–22 hybrid Field amendment and capture real DFL/SkillCorner Tactical Map, Structure Lift, scalar elevation/shadow, tactical structure and split Field/Pose evidence.

migration.stop_rule: Do not start RES-111 or RES-114 until RES-113 is reviewed and accepted.

acceptance.contract: V3 schema and architecture validator pass; RES-109/110 contracts remain intact.
acceptance.fixture: Field, Pose, layers, picking, exact time, worker buffers and split views pass deterministic fixture checks.
acceptance.real_skillcorner: Real DFL and SkillCorner browser evidence captures hybrid Field modes and accepted tactical structure; SkillCorner tracking/Pose identity is selected in either direction and playback stays synchronized by canonical time with explicit source gaps.
acceptance.parity: Player, ball, event, selection, trail, tactical overlay, coordinate and forward/reverse playback parity against the Pixi oracle is recorded before Pixi production retirement.
acceptance.benchmark: Field-only, Pose-only and split scenes are measured at 1600x1000 and 1440x900; Tactical Map and Structure Lift are measured separately, with paired Structure Lift shadow overhead and scalar update cost. WebGPU decision records compatibility, frame timing, draw calls, memory and selection latency.
acceptance.user_review: The owner reviews and explicitly accepts the unified renderer; implementation completion alone does not accept RES-113.
